user_story: As a user, I want to assign a category to a task so that I can organize my tasks.

positive.title: Assign category to task with valid input
steps: Select a task from the list
positive.expected_result: Category is successfully assigned to the task

positive.title: Assign multiple categories to a task
steps: Select a task from the list
Enter the first valid category name and save
Repeat to add a second valid category name and save
positive.expected_result: Multiple categories are successfully assigned to the task

negative.title: Assign category to task with existing category name
steps: Select a task with an existing category
Attempt to assign the same category again
negative.expected_result: Error message shown: 'Category already assigned to this task'

negative.title: Assign category to a non-existent task
steps: Select a task that does not exist
negative.expected_result: Error message shown: 'Task does not exist'

edge.title: Assign category with max length
steps: Select a task from the list
Enter a category name with exactly 255 characters
edge.expected_result: Category is successfully assigned to the task

edge.title: Assign category with special characters
steps: Select a task from the list
Enter a category name with a mix of special characters
edge.expected_result: Validation error: 'Invalid characters in category name'
